ava: quick heads-up — i'm going to push a tiny follow-up to PR #1042 to address a couple of style nits and one variable rename. wanted to check if anyone objects to the rename before i force-push. cc @omar @tj

omar: thanks for the ping. which rename are you thinking?

ava: the loop variable `r` in `runtime/handler.py` — it's shadowing `r` elsewhere and the linter flagged a readability nit. i planned to rename to `resp_buf` (or `response_buf`). also two black/ruff fixes for trailing comma + unused import.

sasha: `response_buf` is a bit long, `resp_buf` seems fine to me. as long as it's consistent across the module. :+1:

maria: small note — if you rename, can you update the comment above the loop? it references `r` in one place.

ava: good catch, will update the comment. i'll run `ruff format` and `black` locally. command i used:```bash
git checkout -b fix/pr-1042-nits
ruff check --fix runtime/handler.py
black runtime/handler.py
git add -A && git commit -m "style: rename r -> resp_buf; run ruff/black"
git push --force-with-lease origin fix/pr-1042-nits
```

omar: sounds good. also please run the small unit tests for kv cache — there was a flake earlier. `pytest tests/kv_cache -q`

ava: running now. should be quick.

ci-bot: CI started for branch fix/pr-1042-nits — running linters and unit tests.

ava: pushed the branch and updated the comment. i left a short note in the PR description about the rename and why (avoid shadowing). requesting review from @omar and @tj.

tj: i'll take a look in ~30m. if it's just formatting + the rename + comment update, i'm ok to approve once CI is green.

maria: quick nit — in the docstring below that function we mention `r` as a response iterator; could be `resp_iter` now. tiny optional follow-up.

ava: i'll change that too while i'm at it. thanks.

ci-bot: CI: linters passed. unit tests: 42 passed, 1 skipped.

omar: LGTM. small change but cleaner. :thumbsup:

tj: approved. go ahead and merge when ready. appreciate the quick cleanup.

ava: merging now after a fast-forward (no conflicts). thanks everyone for the quick reviews.

sasha: thanks for doing the follow-up — nice small tidy.

ava: marking the thread resolved.
